product.title: TL Carbon
product.body_html:
The Amflow TL Carbon is Amflow's first touring and commuting e-bike, and it takes a different path to most: rather than a heavy utility frame, it's built around a 2.9kg full-carbon chassis that brings the complete bike weight down to around 22.6kg (size M) — light for a fully-equipped, full-suspension machine. Amflow describe it as an "SUV e-bike", and that captures it well: it's designed to commute smoothly through the city, carry a serious load on tour, and still handle a rough trail or towpath with real composure.

Suspension is a FOX setup developed specifically for the TL platform — a FOX AWL Sport fork with 120mm of travel up front and a FOX FLOAT Rhythm shock giving 105mm at the rear. That's enough to take the sting out of broken city tarmac, keep a loaded bike settled, and stay comfortable over roots and rougher ground. Comfort-focused touring geometry and strong anti-squat keep you efficient on long days and in control when the road points downhill, and the bike arrives ready to ride with mudguards, a rear rack, lights, a kickstand and pedals all fitted as standard.

Power comes from the DJI Avinox M2 drive unit — 250W rated, with up to 125Nm of peak torque — paired with a removable 800Wh battery that Amflow rate at up to 172km of range. Need more? An optional 480Wh secondary battery takes total capacity to 1280Wh, and the optional charging hub will top up to four batteries in sequence. The Avinox ecosystem rounds things off with a 2-inch OLED display, wireless bar controllers, SmoothShift electronic shifting, app-based route navigation, Apple Find My tracking, a traction control system, and even heart-rate-based assistance.

For carrying, the TL Carbon is rated to roughly 200kg total weight (the bike, a rider up to 125kg, plus up to 20kg on the front rack and 27kg on the rear). A modular mounting design and a MIK HD-compatible rear rack make it easy to add panniers, bags or — with the optional trailer thru-axle — a bike trailer, so it adapts from daily commute to fully-loaded multi-day tour. Both wheels can also be switched between 27.5in and 29in to suit the terrain.

Features

  • Full-carbon frame, approximately 2.9kg — complete bike weight from around 22.6kg (size M)
  • FOX AWL Sport fork, 120mm travel, RAIL 2.0 damper, LSR adjustment — tuned for the TL platform
  • FOX FLOAT Rhythm rear shock, 105mm travel, Amflow TL custom tune
  • DJI Avinox M2 drive unit — 250W rated, up to 125N·m peak torque, five assist modes
  • Removable Avinox RS800 800Wh battery — up to 172km range, expandable to 1280Wh with the optional 480Wh secondary battery
  • Avinox DPC100 2-inch OLED display with two wireless bar controllers
  • Avinox SmoothShift electronic shifting with TRP E.A.S.I. electronic derailleur (10/11-speed)
  • Traction Control System (TCS) for stable power delivery and grip
  • Smart features: offline route navigation (GPX/FIT/TCX), Apple Find My tracking, Bluetooth heart-rate control, GPS and OTA updates
  • Rated to approximately 200kg total weight (max 20kg front rack / 27kg rear rack)
  • Fitted as standard with front and rear mudguards, a MIK HD-compatible rear rack, front and rear lights, kickstand and pedals
  • Modular mounting for panniers, bags and an optional bike trailer (trailer thru-axle required)
  • Tektro TKD173 four-piston hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors
  • Amflow TA dropper post (150mm on S/M, 170mm on L/XL)
  • Switchable between 27.5in and 29in wheels

Specifications::Amflow TL Carbon

  • Discipline: Touring / Commuting e-Bike (full suspension)

  • Material: Full Carbon

  • Front Travel: 120mm

  • Rear Travel: 105mm

  • Wheel Size: 27.5" (29" compatible)

  • Motor: DJI Avinox M2 (250W rated, 125N·m peak)

  • Battery: 800Wh removable (expandable to 1280Wh)

  • Weight: From 22.6kg (size M)

Frame - Amflow TL Carbon, full carbon, Silica Beige; full suspension; removable battery; compatible with 27.5" and 29" wheels; mudguard, rack and trailer compatible
Drive Unit - Avinox M2: 110N·m nominal, 125N·m peak (250W rated)
Battery - Avinox RS800 800Wh, removable; expandable to 1280Wh with optional 480Wh secondary battery
Display - Avinox DPC100, 2-inch OLED Control Display
Controllers - Avinox Wireless Controller × 2 (one each side of the handlebar)
Charger - Avinox 4A Charger, 168W output
Fork - FOX AWL Sport, 120mm, RAIL 2.0 damper, LSR adjustment, 15×110mm Kabolt, 44mm offset
Rear Shock - FOX FLOAT Rhythm, LSR adjustment, Amflow TL tuned, 190×45mm
Rear Derailleur - TRP E.A.S.I. RD-T7010E-L, 10/11-speed electronic
Cassette - Shimano CS-M5243, 10-speed, 11-43T
Chainring - Avinox Direct Mount, 38T
Chain - Avinox eGlide T (10S/11S, 118 links)
Crankset - Avinox SL (S/M: 155mm; L/XL: 160mm)
Brakes - Tektro TKD173 Hydraulic Disc, 4-piston caliper, customised for Amflow
Rotors - Tektro TR180-61E, 180mm, 2.3mm, with integrated tonewheel for Avinox
Wheels - Amflow HTA-25, alloy, 27.5", 25mm inner width, 32H (15×110mm front, 12×148mm rear)
Tyres - Maxxis Crossmark II, 27.5×2.35, EXO, 60TPI
Handlebar - Amflow Touring (S/M: 720mm; L/XL: 740mm; 35mm clamp, 93mm rise)
Stem - Amflow Touring Split Stem, 35mm length, 35mm clamp, 0°
Grips - Amflow Enduro Grip 2
Saddle - Amflow Touring Saddle
Dropper Post - Amflow TA, 31.6mm, adjustable travel 0/-10/-20mm (S/M: 150mm; L/XL: 170mm)
Pedals - Amflow Elite MTB Pedals
Lighting - Avinox front light; Sate-lite M8 rear light with integrated reflector
Mudguards - Front and rear, fitted as standard
Rear Rack - Amflow Touring Rear Rack, MIK HD compatible
Kickstand - Amflow Touring Kickstand (348mm)
Extras - Bottle cage, torque wrench, two battery keys and dropper travel-reducing spacer
